title: [Bug]: Speculative kv_cache_dtype=fp8 crashes startup on hybrid GDN models - FlashInfer "Unrecognized dtype: auto", then native crash on SM89 with explicit target dtype
body:
### Summary Setting a **draft-only** KV cache dtype via `--speculative-config '{"kv_cache_dtype": "fp8", ...}'` on a hybrid GDN model (Qwen3.5-family: full-attention + GDN layers) crashes engine startup in the FlashInfer attention metadata builder: ``` ValueError: Unrecognized dtype: auto ``` The identical launch **without** the speculative `kv_cache_dtype` field works fine (bf16 KV everywhere). Explicitly setting `--kv-cache-dtype bfloat16` on the target (so no group carries the raw `auto`) gets past this error, but the engine then dies with a **native crash** (no Python traceback) during attention init on SM89. Checked against current `main`: both `LLMBaseProposer._create_draft_vllm_config()` (kv_cache_dtype passthrough) and `FlashInferBackend.get_dtype_for_flashinfer()` (no `auto` mapping) are unchanged, so this should still reproduce on main. ### Environment
collect-env (abridged)
vLLM 0.28.0 (pip wheel)
PyTorch 2.13.0+cu130, Python 3.12.3, Ubuntu 24.04
4x RTX 4090 (SM89, PCIe), TP4, CUDA runtime 12.8
Attention backend: FlashInfer (auto-selected; the drafter needs non-causal attention)
Target: Qwen3.5-family hybrid model (full-attn + GDN layers), INT8-W8A16
Draft: DFlash2 drafter (method="dflash")
Full `vllm collect-env` output available on request.
### Reproduction ```bash vllm serve \ --tensor-parallel-size 4 \ --max-model-len 200000 \ --speculative-config '{"method": "dflash", "model": , "num_speculative_tokens": 4, "kv_cache_dtype": "fp8"}' ``` Any hybrid GDN target + draft-model-style speculative method should hit the same path; the draft does not need to be DFlash specifically. ### Actual behavior **Failure 1** - with only the speculative `"kv_cache_dtype": "fp8"`, every TP worker fails during `initialize_kv_cache`: ```python-traceback File "vllm/v1/worker/gpu_worker.py", line 680, in initialize_from_config self.model_runner.initialize_kv_cache(kv_cache_config) File "vllm/v1/worker/gpu/model_runner.py", line 532, in initialize_kv_cache self.attn_groups, attn_cg_support, self.kernel_block_sizes = init_attn_backend(...) File "vllm/v1/worker/gpu/attn_utils.py", line 156, in init_attn_backend group.create_metadata_builders(...) File "vllm/v1/worker/utils.py", line 275, in create_metadata_builders builder_cls(...) File "vllm/v1/attention/backends/flashinfer.py", line ~840, in FlashInferMetadataBuilder.__init__ self.kv_cache_dtype = FlashInferBackend.get_dtype_for_flashinfer(...) File "vllm/v1/attention/backends/flashinfer.py", line 514, in get_dtype_for_flashinfer raise ValueError(f"Unrecognized dtype: {kv_cache_dtype}") ValueError: Unrecognized dtype: auto ``` `get_dtype_for_flashinfer()` only maps `fp8`/`fp8_e4m3`/`fp8_e5m2`/`nvfp4*`. In the normal single-dtype flow the raw `auto` is resolved to the model dtype before attention init; with a speculative `kv_cache_dtype` set, at least one attention group of the hybrid model appears to receive the **unresolved** string. Likely suspects: the GDN KV group, or the target-side group of the multi-group KV config created alongside the draft config. **Failure 2** - adding `--kv-cache-dtype bfloat16` (target) so no group carries `auto`: ``` ERROR [core.py:1346] EngineCore failed to start. ERROR [multiproc_executor.py:311] Worker proc VllmWorker-3 died unexpectedly (exit code: None) ``` i.e. a native crash of one worker during (draft) attention initialization on SM89, no Python traceback. The FlashInfer fp8-KV path appears to be non-functional on Ada for this (draft, non-causal) configuration, and it takes the whole engine down instead of failing backend selection with a readable error. ### Expected behavior Either: 1. draft KV cache dtype is honored (draft fp8, target bf16), or 2. startup fails fast with a clear error, e.g. "fp8 draft KV cache is not supported with backend FlashInfer on SM89", instead of `ValueError: Unrecognized dtype: auto` / silent worker native crash. ### Related issues - #48380 / PR #48381 - same family (draft inheriting a target-only KV dtype), but for MLA `fp8_ds_mla` layouts; this report is the draft-only `fp8` path on a hybrid GDN target. - #44184, #48406 - fp8 KV cache crashes together with spec decode. - #49077, #52202 - fp8 KV support work for pre-SM89 GPUs. - #54341 - fp8_e5m2/e4m3 KV writer mismatches. Happy to test patches / provide full logs.
